trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 115 degrees; shallow vertical depth relative to horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged serrations across the continuous trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits deeper valleys (approx. 10-15 pixel amplitude) compared to the left lobe. Pattern is non-uniform with roughly 18-22 distinct peaks per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a general concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips, characterized by high-frequency local deviations due to serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters present on both distal tips. Right lobe tip contains a dense, roughly circular aggregate of white spots (approx. 45x60 pixel area). Left lobe tip shows more dispersed, smaller white clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular marginal erosion on both distal lobe tips, with the right tip showing more significant tissue loss/jaggedness.
